method: All five declared functions retained, including tool errors and unsupported/uncertain answers. Identical binary, symbols, no debug or supplied types for both sides. Static analysis only. No timing ranking. Questions frozen before outputs. Source/instruction gold separate from anonymous answering packets.

questions.question: What ordered input carriers and widths are supported, and what integer transformation does this function perform? Distinguish observed inference from an exact source signature; cite instruction or proof references.

Which function is called, what are the ordered known arguments, and what happens to its result? Report observed result widths and whether exact call arity is proven or open; cite references and preserve uncertainty.
What memory field offsets and widths and element stride are observed? Are array bounds known? Explain the returned calculation, citing references without inventing source field names or bounds.
Is the integer division signed, what width is observed, and what constraints or unresolved behavior must a caller account for? Cite references and distinguish unproven preconditions from facts.

Is the call target direct or indirect, what ordered arguments and result widths are known, and is exact target identity/arity proven? What happens after the call? Preserve uncertainty and cite references.
